summary: Short, very steep residential kerb with homes within 10 m.
reasons: Cars park here but narrow kerb

best_section.where: Moorak Street west kerb, upslope end near the corner

drivers.seclusion: Houses on the same side beside the kerb; dwelling 8 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside lane where other cars park, but the street is narrow.
drivers.convention: Residents park here; 2P resident-permit signs Mon-Fri 7am-7pm.

sun_shade: Tree canopy over the kerb from the west side.
